model.title: Brian Head Town Land Conveyance Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Forest Service to transfer roughly 24 acres of National Forest land to Brian Head Town, Utah, at no cost to the town. The town could then use the property for a public works facility or other purposes it determines necessary.
